name: Ground to Keep
summary: Groundskeeper Lomar asks you to drive intruders from Stromgarde Keep. The kingdom’s remaining sculptures and sacred burial grounds need protection.

sections.title: A Kingdom's Remains
sections.body: In Stromgarde Keep, Groundskeeper Lomar asks you to drive back the Boulderfist, Syndicate, and Witherbark intruders. He says Stromgarde has more in reserve, and that it must stay hidden for its own protection. Support is growing for preserving the kingdom’s remaining sculptures and sacred burial grounds.

faq.answer: Groundskeeper Lomar asks you to drive the Boulderfist, Syndicate, and Witherbark intruders from Stromgarde Keep.

faq.q: Why should Stromgarde’s remains be protected?
faq.answer: Support is growing for preserving Stromgarde’s remaining sculptures and sacred burial grounds.

faq.q: Which intruders are in Stromgarde Keep?
faq.answer: The Boulderfist, Syndicate, and Witherbark have taken up residence in Stromgarde Keep.
Lomar says Stromgarde has more in reserve, and it must remain hidden for its own protection.

attribution: In-game quest text: Ground to Keep
